title: Read conversation history
summary: Page forward or backward through turns.
purpose: Page forward or backward through turns.
request: {{route:conversation.turns}}. Use `after_seq` with `include_head=1` to page forward, or `before_seq` to read older turns. For context preceding `after_seq=start`, start with `before_seq=start+1`.
response: Continue with `next_after_seq` or `prev_before_seq`. Backward reads leave token consumption and the forward read cursor unchanged.
errors: If both direction parameters were sent, retry with one.
